manifest.name: Loco
manifest.workers: Tokio multi-threaded runtime, one worker per available CPU (2)
manifest.database_layer: SeaORM 2.0 (find_by_id, ActiveModel::update, Entity::find().all), pool max_connections = DB_POOL_SIZE
manifest.logging: none per request (logger middleware off in config/production.yaml); application logger at warn

phase2.validation: Loco's QueryValidate, JsonValidate and FormValidate extractors (validator 0.20: 400; Axum's Json data errors 422, Form parse errors 422); Path<i32> (400)

csrf.mechanism: axum_csrf 0.12 layer on /form and /login (token in an encrypted cookie, HMAC in the form field)

session.mechanism: Loco auth_session feature, default cookie store (Session, CurrentUser<users::Model>)

manifest.notes: Structure, features and production.yaml as loco new generates them for a PostgreSQL app with server-side views.
